step_name: Final Assembly / Movie Lane (visible-speaker lip sync)

problem_statement.speaker: Kai
problem_statement.canonical_line: If we paddle now, we're cutting across the lineup.
problem_statement.summary: The frozen predecessor return (rev_upstream_bf3b05d47fb8, request sha256:ca90ba9f...) post-muxed the exact Kai line at 5.00-7.70s. Forced alignment PASSED (canonical text exact, onset/end in tolerance). But SB_003 is a medium-wide waterline two-shot in which Kai's face and mouth are camera-readable while his measured dialogue is audible, and no lip-sync transform was applied, so step 38 fails. The successor rev_successor_943b01ecd9a3 regenerated 8 identity frames but did NOT change SB_003 composition or the post-mux audio strategy, so a next paid Kling call compiled from the current SB_003 contract would return a video that fails step 38 identically.
problem_statement.goal_rule_cited: GOAL.md Completion Rule: 'When the speaker's mouth is visible, post-mux audio without an accepted lip-sync transform cannot satisfy the immutable goal.'

muxed_provider_return_mp4.note: 10.041667s exceeds the fal Kling lipsync audio-to-video 2-10s video cap by 0.041667s; segment isolation or a 60s-cap lane is required for a whole-return lip-sync.

candidate_lanes.name: Kling lip-sync API lane (post-return video+audio -> lip-synced video)
candidate_lanes.operates_on: A returned video (Kling-generated OR any external MP4/MOV with a clear, steady, mostly-in-frame frontal face). It is a post-return repair, not a pre-call fix.

kling_direct_classic.auth: JWT HS256, iss=$KLING_ACCESS_KEY, exp=now+7200, nbf=now, signed with $KLING_SECRET_KEY (same pattern documented in SKILL.md for custom-voices; the direct provider is the api-singapore.klingai.com base URL).
kling_direct_classic.video_source: input.video_id / origin_task_id (a prior Kling-generated task in the same account) OR external video_url

kling_direct_advanced.audio: Base64-encoded audio OR accessible audio URL; .mp3/.wav/.m4a/.aac; max 5MB; 2-60s
constraints: audio before the starting point is cropped; the cropped sound must be >= 2s

useapi_wrapper.note: video up to 60s; audio shorter than video mutes the excess, longer is discarded; supports replyUrl callback

cost_estimate.for_this_repair: Lip-syncing only the SB_003 sub-segment (~2.7-3s of the 5.0-7.7s spoken interval) is on the order of $0.08-0.10 plus one additional paid provider call beyond the Kling video generation call.

constraints_and_risks: PAID: adds a second paid provider call on top of the successor Kling video generation call.

POST-RETURN ONLY: cannot run or be validated before the next paid Kling call; it only repairs a video that has already been returned. It does not change what the next paid Kling call receives, so the next return would still be visible-speaker-unsynced and require this repair afterward.
10.041667s return exceeds the fal 2-10s video cap; the whole-return path needs the direct provider/useapi (60s) lane, OR segment isolation of just the SB_003 window followed by re-splice.

ONE PERSON only: SB_003 is a two-shot (Kai + Embry). The model must lock onto Kai's face; a two-face frame risks the wrong face being driven or Embry's mouth being disturbed. Requires a clear, steady Kai face over most frames of the fed segment.

Audio placement: 'audio before the starting point is cropped'; the driving audio must be the ISOLATED Kai line (~2.7s), not the full 10s mix (which contains ocean ambience during Kai's silence and would drive spurious mouth motion). This forces a segment-level lip-sync + recomposite back into the 10s timeline, then a re-mux and re-review.
CONTINGENT: if the successor Kling return still fails Embry identity (step 36, EMBRY_IDENTITY_DRIFT), lip-sync repair is moot; identity must pass first.
Adds a new provider request hash, a new hash-bound paid authorization, and a fresh forced-alignment + visible-speaker re-review cycle on the recomposited output.
receipts_gates_required_for_step38: New hash-bound paid-call authorization for the lip-sync request (step 30 analog).
Kling lip-sync submit + poll/callback receipts (external task id, provider task id).
Downloaded lip-synced segment + ffprobe receipt (readability, duration).
Re-splice/re-mux FFmpeg receipt placing the lip-synced Kai segment back at 5.0-7.7s in the 10s timeline.
Re-run dialogue_forced_alignment_receipt.v1 on the recomposited MP4 (canonical text still exact, onset/end in tolerance).
Audio-stream + audible-output review on the final MP4.

candidate_lanes.name: generate_audio=true (provider-generated audio carries the line)
candidate_lanes.finding: Kling/fal video generation audio is ambient/generic sound, not scripted dialogue rendered from an exact transcript in a specific consented voice. It cannot be made to speak the canonical Kai line verbatim, and even if it emitted speech it would be a non-consented synthetic voice with non-verbatim words.
why_it_breaks_the_goal: GOAL.md Completion Rule for a voiced run requires 'an exact transcript render' plus a forced-alignment receipt on the canonical line. Provider-generated audio is not verbatim, so canonical_text_exact_after_normalization would fail.

Step 37 requires the consented/provenance-bound Kai voice ('The output voice must be a curated authorized reference / consented voice'); a provider TTS voice is neither consented nor identity-bound to Kai.
It would replace, not satisfy, the post-mux exact-line lane; the exact-transcript requirement is immutable and cannot be traded away for provider audio.

cost_estimate.note: N/A - rejected; would still incur the same Kling video cost but produce a non-compliant audio track.

receipts_gates_required_for_step38: Not applicable: this lane cannot produce a PASS forced-alignment on the canonical line nor a consented-voice receipt.

candidate_lanes.name: SB_003 composition change (make the visible-speaker rule inapplicable)
candidate_lanes.principle: GOAL.md makes lip-sync mandatory ONLY when the speaker's mouth is visible during the measured speech. If Kai's mouth is NOT camera-readable during 5.0-7.7s, the post-mux exact-line strategy (which already PASSES forced alignment) satisfies step 38 by construction, with no additional paid call.

minimal_change.keep_start_frame: sb_003.start_frame is UNCHANGED. Kai's face stays readable at the top of the beat so his identity is reference-verifiable (satisfies identity_requirements.Kai.face_required and preserves the accepted-frame identity anchor).
minimal_change.change_end_frame_and_motion: During the spoken interval (5.0-7.7s) and in sb_003.end_frame, Kai delivers his one restrained cue while looking OUT toward the lineup/reef he is reading (three-quarter-away / over-the-shoulder from camera) and/or mid-paddle stroke with forearm and spray across the lower face, so his lips are NOT camera-readable during the measured speech. This is story-true: the beat is Kai reading the lineup and giving a restrained cue while facing the water he references.
minimal_change.identity_preserved: Identity is proven by the readable start frame and by Kai's build/wardrobe/hair continuity; only the lips-camera-readability during the ~2.7s spoken window is removed.
minimal_change.story_intent_preserved: Kai conserves energy, reads local/channel/reef/Embry's cadence, holds position, gives one restrained cue; Embry keeps agency. All acting beats survive.

regeneration_triggered: Regenerate SB_003 END frame only (GPT Image 2 via scillm, the established Phase C lane; no new provider, no video/paid call).
SB_003 START frame is retained as-is (identity anchor).
Continuity re-review of 2 pairs: sb_003_start -> sb_003_end (new end frame) and sb_003_end -> sb_004_start (neighbor).
Update the Kling per-segment motion prompt for the sb_003 window so Kai turns toward the lineup / paddle-obscures his mouth while delivering the cue.
No change to sb_001, sb_002, sb_004+ frames; no change to the post-mux audio, the rendered Kai WAV, or the forced-alignment lane.

cost_estimate.note: One GPT-Image-2 frame regeneration on the existing image lane (no incremental provider cost tracked as a paid Kling/video call). No lip-sync provider call. This is the cheapest lane and the only one that fixes the failure BEFORE the paid Kling call.

receipts_gates_required_for_step38: Regenerated sb_003.end_frame with an actual-pixel identity review PASS (Kai + Embry identity still reference-verifiable) matching the Phase C reviewer bar.
Continuity review PASS for sb_003_start->end and sb_003_end->sb_004_start.

Updated SB_003 panel_prompt_contract.v2 encoding: during the spoken interval Kai's mouth is not camera-readable (a new visibility field, e.g. speaker_mouth_camera_readable_during_speech=false), rehashed and re-bound in the artifact index.

On the eventual Kling return: dialogue_forced_alignment_receipt.v1 PASS (unchanged post-mux lane) AND visible_speaker_lipsync_review.v1 recording observations.speaker_mouth_visible=false during 5.0-7.7s -> status PASS_VISIBLE_SPEAKER_RULE_INAPPLICABLE (post-mux sufficient because the mouth is not readable during measured speech).

decision.primary_lane_name: SB_003 composition change (speaker mouth not camera-readable during the spoken interval)
decision.fallback_lane_name: Kling lip-sync API lane (post-return segment lip-sync + recomposite)
rationale: The task boundary is BEFORE the next paid Kling call. Only lane C changes what that call receives, so the next return can PASS step 38 by construction; lanes A and B do not change the next call's inputs.

Lane C is non-paid, deterministic, and uses the already-proven GPT-Image-2 storyboard lane; it removes only the ~2.7s of camera-readable lips while preserving identity (start frame) and full story intent.
Lane C keeps the post-mux exact-line strategy, which already PASSES forced alignment with the consented Kai voice - it does not disturb step 37.

Lane A is retained as the fallback because it directly repairs a returned video's visible-speaker sync, but it is post-return, paid, single-face-in-a-two-shot risky, blocked by the 10.041667s > 10s fal cap (needs segment isolation or the 60s direct/useapi lane), and contingent on Embry identity (step 36) passing first.
Lane B is rejected: provider-generated audio cannot carry the exact canonical line verbatim in the consented Kai voice and would break the immutable exact-transcript and consented-voice requirements.
decision.what_this_authorizes: Nothing paid. If the human selects lane C, the follow-up is a single SB_003 end-frame regeneration + continuity re-review (still non-paid on the image lane) and a per-segment Kling motion-prompt update, THEN the successor provider request is compiled. If the human selects lane A, a new hash-bound paid authorization is required for the lip-sync call.

proves: The step 38 visible-speaker failure has a documented root cause (SB_003 two-shot with Kai's mouth camera-readable during the measured 5.0-7.7s post-mux line) and three evaluated resolutions with costs, constraints, and gates.
A non-paid primary resolution (SB_003 composition change) exists that would let the next paid Kling call pass step 38 by construction while preserving identity and story intent.
The Kling lip-sync API facts (endpoints, auth, formats, duration/one-person constraints, cost) are researched and cited, and a fully-specified but UNSENT fallback request template is recorded.
does_not_prove: That the regenerated SB_003 end frame will pass actual-pixel identity + continuity review (must be verified when regenerated).
That a Kling lip-sync call would produce a visually accepted result on a two-shot segment.
That the successor Kling return will pass Embry identity (step 36), which remains a separate open blocker.
Any human paid authorization - none is granted by this packet.
